moves.actual_outcome: The +601.015 basis is applied but this trace is still pending (disabled Trace route, no outcome), then superseded by020. Seeded banner is absent after reconstruction. Exact-boundary success is established later by024.

Treat the observed result as evidence and the wait as a tool failure; do not count timeout as a product stall or claim active seed.
